MCPRequest.description: MCP tool invocation envelope. Sent by consumers (VS Code, web-shell) to the MCP server. Closes audit §3.1 row 13.

input.description: Free-form per-tool input payload (Article XV.2 exception — narrowed by per-tool Pydantic input model at dispatch).

tool.description: Tool name (one of SessionMCPToolName for the session-state server).

MCPRequest.title: MCPRequest

MCPContentItem.description: A single MCP content item (resource, text, or image). Carries Debrief-specific annotations (debrief:* keys) on every item. Closes audit §3.1 row 15.

annotations.description: Debrief-specific annotations (`debrief:resultType`, `debrief:label`, `debrief:sourceFeatures`, etc). Free-form per Article XV.2 because the key set is open-ended and uses colons (`debrief:*`) that LinkML cannot constrain as slot names.

mimeType.description: IANA media type when type=image or type=resource.

resource.description: Nested resource descriptor `{ uri, mimeType, text }` when type=resource. Free-form per Article XV.2 (the inner shape is driven by individual tool authors).

type.description: Content-item discriminator. Current consumers emit `resource`, `text`, `image`. Kept as string to remain additive over any future MCP content-item types.

MCPContentItem.title: MCPContentItem

MCPToolResponse.description: Successful MCP tool response. Closes audit §3.1 row 16. The `duration_ms` slot preserves the wire format used by the live MCP server and replay subsystem.

content.description: Ordered list of content items returned by the tool.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the tool invocation in milliseconds.

is_error.description: Reserved for streaming partial-error responses (additive over the live wire format).

structured_content.description: Reserved for top-level free-form payload (e.g. vega-spec) — Article XV.2 exception. Additive over the live wire format.

MCPToolResponse.title: MCPToolResponse

MCPErrorResponse.description: MCP error response envelope. Closes audit §3.1 row 17. The error payload is nested (matches the JSON-RPC convention used by the live server).

error.description: Nested error object `{ code, message, data: { debrief:errorCategory, debrief:affectedFeatures } }`. Free-form per Article XV.2 because the inner `data` map uses colon-bearing keys outside LinkML slot syntax.

MCPErrorResponse.title: MCPErrorResponse
